put.description:
Replace the project's hand-editable seed classes under optimistic locking (expected_version). All classes live in one seeds.json and share one version counter, so one PUT may carry several of them and any accepted PUT bumps the version for all.

`field_meanings` is REQUIRED: omitting it is a 422, never 'clear all'. `metric_definitions`, `entity_notes` and `verified_answers` are OPTIONAL: omitted (or null) leaves that class exactly as stored, so an editor that only knows about one class cannot wipe the others; send an empty list to clear a class deliberately.

Every supplied list fully replaces its class — there is no per-row patch. Seed classes this endpoint does not accept (verified relations, column role seeds) are always untouched.

Same fields as the `plan.pending` stream frame, so a client that lost its

card without replaying the turn.

CleaningApplied.title: CleaningApplied
CleaningApplied.description:
Apply outcome: the cleaned version plus the fork job analyzing it.

`target_version` is None on an idempotent replay, where only the job row
survives to answer from.

CleaningLogView.title: CleaningLogView
CleaningLogView.description:
The four cleaning-transparency tables for one run.

`recipe_count` is 0 when the run recorded no CleaningRecipe at all, which is
what separates "nothing was cleaned" from "cleaned, but nothing deleted".

CleaningPreviewView.title: CleaningPreviewView
CleaningPreviewView.description: Row/column diff summary for a recipe — never the cleaned frame itself.

CleaningRawView.title: CleaningRawView
CleaningRawView.description:
Before-cleaning snapshot of a run.

`precleaning_recorded` is False when the run carries no raw profile, chart,
preview, or cleaning recipe — i.e. pre-cleaning was never enabled. When it is
True, an empty list means that category alone was not recorded.

ClientFailureRequest.title: ClientFailureRequest
ClientFailureRequest.description:
Privacy-minimal handled UI failure. Free text and request data are
deliberately absent; extra keys are rejected instead of silently stored.

ColumnDistribution.title: ColumnDistribution
ColumnDistribution.description:
One column's mini distribution. Numeric columns fill counts/bin_edges/
min/max; categorical columns fill top/other_count/unique_count/len_*; an
all-null column fills neither and reports kind "empty".

ColumnDistributionsView.title: ColumnDistributionsView
ColumnDistributionsView.description:
Structured per-column distributions; the client draws them.

`sampled` / `sample_rows` carry the footnote: above `sample_cap` rows the
stats come from a random sample, not the full table.

CompareScopeField.title: CompareScopeField
CompareScopeField.description:
One bounded, display-ready property of a scope record.

Scope APIs deliberately do not return arbitrary artifact payloads. Complex
values are summarized by the application service into text/list/code
fields, while comparison itself uses a private canonical representation.

CompareScopeView.title: CompareScopeView
CompareScopeView.description: Shared envelope for every lazily loaded semantic comparison scope.

CompareSessionSide.title: CompareSessionSide

CompareView.title: CompareView
CompareView.description: Two runs of one project side by side (§10.3 Compare).

CustomChartView.title: CustomChartView
CustomChartView.description:
A ready-to-render vega-lite spec with its rows inlined at
`spec.data.values`. `row_count` 0 is the empty state, not an error.

DecisionCoverageView.title: DecisionCoverageView
DecisionCoverageView.description:
Deterministic coverage across every run of the viewed run's project,
computed on read. `top_cards_total` 0 means nothing to assess yet.

DecisionReportView.title: DecisionReportView
DecisionReportView.description:

InvestigationDecisionPrepared.title: InvestigationDecisionPrepared
InvestigationDecisionPrepared.description:

The approval binds the plan's content fingerprint: a plan rebuilt after

InvestigationDecisionRequest.title: InvestigationDecisionRequest

InvestigationExecuteRequest.title: InvestigationExecuteRequest
InvestigationExecuteRequest.description: No plan ids: execution runs exactly the set the approval froze.

InvestigationExecutionStarted.description:

InvestigationPlanBuildStarted.title: InvestigationPlanBuildStarted
InvestigationPlanBuildStarted.description:
The derived ``ipsess_*`` run carrying a plan-building job.

Plan building is deterministic and spends no model budget, so it needs no
approval; the plans it writes land on their own ``investigation_*`` run,
which the job reports in an ``investigation.planned`` trace event.

InvestigationPlanView.title: InvestigationPlanView
InvestigationPlanView.description: One investigation plan plus its decision and terminal outcome.

LlmDebugRecord.title: LlmDebugRecord

MacroLoopPrepared.title: MacroLoopPrepared
MacroLoopPrepared.description:
Pending approval for the Ultra macro loop over one executed plan run.

Approving this authorizes the loop to generate and execute follow-up

without a further prompt.

MacroLoopStarted.title: MacroLoopStarted
MacroLoopStarted.description: The derived ``mlsess_*`` run carrying a macro-loop job.

MacroLoopView.title: MacroLoopView

QuestionDraftPrepared.description:

QuestionDraftRequest.title: QuestionDraftRequest
QuestionDraftRequest.description: No question field: drafting runs the text bound into the approval.

QuestionDraftStarted.description:

The new candidate is appended to the SOURCE run's QuestionCandidateSet; the
derived run only carries the job lifecycle.

QuestionExecuteRequest.title: QuestionExecuteRequest
QuestionExecuteRequest.description:

QuestionExecutionPrepared.title: QuestionExecutionPrepared
QuestionExecutionPrepared.description: Pending approval for executing one question (§6.0 approval contract).

RelationshipDiscoveryStarted.title: RelationshipDiscoveryStarted
RelationshipDiscoveryStarted.description:
The derived run carrying an on-demand relationship discovery job.

Discovery reads every source CSV, so it never runs on page load; the
candidate artifacts it produces land on ``session_id`` (the source run), while
``execution_session_id`` is the ``rdsess_*`` run that only carries the lifecycle.

RelationshipEdge.title: RelationshipEdge

One directed join hypothesis with everything the Inspector shows.

`state` is the render tier: candidate (scored only) → validated (DuckDB
verified) → confirmed (a user or auto-confirmation promoted the join).

RelationshipGraphView.title: RelationshipGraphView
RelationshipGraphView.description: Nodes + edges for one run, shaped from existing artifacts only.

RelationshipNode.title: RelationshipNode
RelationshipNode.description: One dataset of the run, as a node of the relationship graph.

RelationshipValidateRequest.title: RelationshipValidateRequest
RelationshipValidateRequest.description: No candidate content on purpose: validation runs what the approval froze.

RelationshipValidationPrepared.title: RelationshipValidationPrepared
RelationshipValidationPrepared.description: Pending approval for one full relationship validation (§6.0 contract).

RelationshipValidationStarted.title: RelationshipValidationStarted
RelationshipValidationStarted.description: The derived run carrying the validation job, plus the job itself.

ReportGenerationStarted.title: ReportGenerationStarted
ReportGenerationStarted.description:
The derived run carrying an on-demand report generation job.

The report artifacts land on ``session_id`` (the source run); ``execution_session_id``
is the ``rpsess_*`` run that only carries the job lifecycle.

ReportView.title: ReportView
ReportView.description:
Report reader payload. status "none" (empty markdown) means the run has
no report yet — that is a normal 200, not an error.

SandboxStatusView.title: SandboxStatusView
SandboxStatusView.description: Which execution backend untrusted analysis code would get right now.

SemanticView.title: SemanticView
SemanticView.description: The project semantic layer viewed from one run.

SessionDebugView.title: SessionDebugView
SessionDebugView.description: Developer-inspector rollup for one session (Trace / debug panel).

SessionDetail.title: SessionDetail
SessionDetail.description: Session metadata only — never artifact payloads, report text, or frames.

SessionForkRequest.title: SessionForkRequest
SessionForkRequest.description:
Exactly one decision varies. `ml_target` re-runs the same inputs with a
different (or no) baseline target; `dataset` re-runs on the chosen tables.

SessionForkStarted.title: SessionForkStarted
SessionForkStarted.description:
The derived run carrying a what-if fork job.

``execution_session_id`` is the ``fksess_*`` lifecycle run; the forked analysis
mints its own ordinary run id, which the job reports in its ``session.forked``
trace event once the fork starts producing it.

SessionMetricsView.title: SessionMetricsView
SessionMetricsView.description:
Trace & cost rollup. `source` is "artifact" when the run persisted a
SessionMetrics artifact, "aggregated" when it was recomputed from trace events.

SettingsPatch.title: SettingsPatch
SettingsPatch.description:
Partial update; omitted fields keep their current value.

``api_key`` is write-only and never echoed back — repr is suppressed so it
cannot reach a log line through an exception or debug dump.

SettingsView.title: SettingsView
SettingsView.description:
Effective settings for the calling session. Carries no API key — only
whether one is set and its last 4 characters.

SkillParamSpec.title: SkillParamSpec
SkillParamSpec.description: One placeholder a seed template requires before it can be replayed.

SkillPlanCandidate.title: SkillPlanCandidate
SkillPlanCandidate.description: A validated plan artifact of this run that can be frozen into a skill.

SkillReplayExecuteRequest.title: SkillReplayExecuteRequest
SkillReplayExecuteRequest.description: No skill content on purpose: execute replays what the approval froze.

SkillReplayPrepared.title: SkillReplayPrepared
SkillReplayPrepared.description: Pending approval for replaying one skill (§6.0 approval contract).

SkillReplayStarted.title: SkillReplayStarted
SkillReplayStarted.description: Replay outcome: the derived run holding the result plus its job.

SkillTargetColumn.title: SkillTargetColumn
SkillTargetColumn.description: A column of a replay target, and whether a seed may bind to it.

SkillTargetDataset.title: SkillTargetDataset
SkillTargetDataset.description: A replay target in the current run, with the columns bindings may use.

SkillTemplateBound.title: SkillTemplateBound
SkillTemplateBound.description:
A user template bound into a library skill, plus the trial-run preview
that proves the instantiated SQL really executes on the target dataset.

SkillTemplateCreateRequest.title: SkillTemplateCreateRequest
SkillTemplateCreateRequest.description: User-writable subset of a seed template; the id is server-generated.

SkillTemplateView.title: SkillTemplateView
SkillTemplateView.description: One SQL analysis template: a builtin seed or a user-defined one.

StatTestRow.title: StatTestRow
StatTestRow.description: One StatTestResult; p_value/statistic stay at stored precision.

SystemCapabilitiesView.title: SystemCapabilitiesView
SystemCapabilitiesView.description:
Optional-dependency features, so the UI can disable what this host
cannot do instead of offering a button that 503s.

TraceEventPage.title: TraceEventPage
TraceEventPage.description:
Trace page plus the run's event-type histogram, so the client filter does
not need a second request.

UsageDay.title: UsageDay
UsageDay.description: One UTC calendar day of the activity window.

UsageRecentSession.title: UsageRecentSession
UsageRecentSession.description: A session on the home page's cross-project recency list.

VerifiedRelationDeleteRequest.title: VerifiedRelationDeleteRequest
VerifiedRelationDeleteRequest.description: Identity of the row to drop, not its list position.

VerifiedRelationView.title: VerifiedRelationView
VerifiedRelationView.description:
One user-confirmed join sunk into the semantic seeds. `left`/`right` are
seed-side keys (`dataset.col[+col...]`), which together identify the row.

WorkspaceUsageView.title: WorkspaceUsageView
WorkspaceUsageView.description:
Period-scoped cross-run rollup for the workspace home.

Every other trace figure is per-run, so a dashboard had to fan out one
request per session to say anything about the workspace. Cost is summed
only over sessions that persisted a metrics artifact; `unpriced_sessions`
reports the rest rather than letting them vanish into the total.
``project_count``, ``data_bytes``, and ``recent`` remain workspace-wide;
session-derived figures are scoped by last activity to ``window_days``.
